ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

counter.label: Limited to 100 characters
counter.note: Automatically shown when maxlength is set on the textarea.

textarea.description: Styling and integration directive for native <textarea>. Works standalone and integrated with Form Field.

examples.note: Standalone textarea with its own visual shell. Placeholder is an example, never a label replacement.

form-field.label: Description
form-field.note: Label, hint, and visual shell managed by Form Field. Height is delegated to the Form Field wrapper; the textarea keeps text, caret, selection, and placeholder.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the textarea directive with Form Field.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: Radius is owned by Form Field when projected; the standalone textarea exposes the same none, sm, md, lg, and xl values. Global scale: md maps to 4px, lg to 8px, and xl renders as a pill.

resize.note: Resize handle follows the resize input. Horizontal and both modes resize the Form Field wrapper; the textarea itself never shows a second handle.

rows.label: With rows=4
rows.note: Textarea respects the native rows attribute.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: Form Field owns the outer height, the textarea keeps its own font and padding in sync.

textarea.title: Textarea
